_comment: User-confirmed corrections to wiki notecounts, applied by run_pipeline.py on every run (the enriched snapshot and master.json are regenerated, so corrections must live here, not there). Keyed by song id + chart key; only the fields named are replaced. Retire an entry when the upstream wiki value catches up — the run log prints a NOTE when an override becomes a no-op.

corrections.reason: BEMANIWiki/RemyWiki list 593 notes, but the game's own MAX COMBO is 595 and a verified play (judge sum 595, O.K. 6 = all freezes held, no shocks, EX cross-check exact) proves 595 tap judgments. The 3 simultaneous presses cannot explain a surplus — simultaneity only merges or is neutral. Confirmed by the user 2026-11-27.
